title: Place a device sheet or Vault sheet on a schematic
summary: Places a device sheet as a sheet symbol by running Sch:CreateSheetSymbolFromSheet without interaction, and starts placing a Vault sheet item revision found by HRID with DM_UseItemRevision.
phrasings: place a device sheet symbol programmatically
insert a reusable sheet into a schematic
find a device sheet file by name
place a sheet from the workspace by HRID
run a built-in process without a dialog

commands.name: PlaceDeviceSheet
commands.description: Resolve a device sheet by name and place it as a sheet symbol on the active schematic with Sch:CreateSheetSymbolFromSheet; reports the sheet symbols that appeared
commands.params: Name=<device sheet name, required; the menu passes TestDeviceSheet>|X=<mils, default 5000>|Y=<mils, default 5000>|DryRun=<true: resolve only, do not place>

commands.name: PlaceSheetFromVault
commands.description: Look up a Vault sheet item revision by HRID and start placing it on the active schematic with DM_UseItemRevision
commands.params: Hrid=<item revision HRID, required; the menu passes SCH-0001-00021-1>|Vault=<index, default 0>|DryRun=<true: look up only, do not place>
